libctru, the 3DS homebrew system library (devkitPro's libctru package),
linked statically into tssm.3dsx.

libctru is under the zlib licence below, as its README.md gives it (tag
v2.7.0 of https://github.com/devkitPro/libctru); libctru names no copyright
holder.

devkitARM's C library (newlib) and the GCC runtime (libgcc, libstdc++) are in
the image as well. newlib's licences are in its COPYING.NEWLIB and
COPYING.LIBGLOSS (https://github.com/devkitPro/newlib, branch devkitPro); the
GCC runtime is under the GPL 3 with the GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1
(https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gcc-exception-3.1.html), which asks nothing of
programs built with it.
